text:
sam: FYI team: planned readonly-replica maintenance and drain in us-east-2 on Thu 22:00-22:20 UTC. We're applying a patch to the replica query planner. No primary changes. Expect short p95/p99 read latency blips and a few harmless 5xxs while the replica rebalances.
rachel: Will this affect customer-facing write latency?
sam: No writes unaffected. Read-heavy endpoints that prefer replica may see retries. We'll set retry budgets and divert ~15% of traffic to the primary for the 10m peak.
omar: Can we get the runbook + dashboard?
sam: Runbook: https://confluence.internal/ops/readonly-replica-maint. Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/ops/replica-health.
sre-bot: Maintenance scheduled: readonly-replica-maint-3141592653. Oncall ack required 15m prior.
infra-lead: Proposing temporary SLO slice: us-east reads p99 800ms -> 1600ms for 21:55-22:25 UTC to avoid automated throttles. Auto-revert at 22:25.
oncall-b: Acked. I'll monitor replica lag and retry counts. Add a synthetic that measures read error % and p99 latency.
omar: Added synthetic: https://synthetics.internal/check/replica-read-us-east-2. Also adding a circuit breaker to prevent cascading retries.
sam: Rollback steps in runbook: stop drain job, restore traffic weights, and failover not needed. Commands:
```
# stop drain
kubectl -n infra delete job replica-drain-3141592653
# restore weights
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/traffic -d '{"region":"us-east-2","primary_weight":85}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CTRL'
```
infra-lead: Post-mortem criteria: open postmortem if read error rate >0.5% sustained >10m or replica lag >8s. Otherwise log maintenance note.
rachel: I'll prepare a short internal note for support if needed.
oncall-b: I'll be in-channel during the window, watching canaries. Ping at 15m, 5m.
sam: Thanks. Closing thread for now.
